title: Unit 1: Let's give a hand
content:
Mike: I'd like to invite you all to my birthday party this weekend. Although it'll be my birthday, I don't want any presents. Instead, I hope you can donate money to the Heroes for Animals Society. It's a charity which helps animals. I became a volunteer for it last month. I feel bad to hear that animals don't have a safe home, so I want to help them.

Anna: Really? What do the volunteers do?

Mike: Some volunteers help sell flags in the street. There are some other volunteers who help online. I'm one of them. Last month, I filmed a video to encourage people to donate money and posted it online. Although it took time, it was meaningful.

Anna: We watched your video! It has inspired us to do voluntary work. Next month, I'm going to visit an elderly home and make crafts with the elderly. Some elderly people may feel bored. I hope spending time with them will bring them joy.

Kelly: I'm going to give away old books to a charity. That way, other people can enjoy them.

Nathan: I'm going to go on a walkathon for a children's hospital. It's a great way to raise money for sick children. I understand that many sick children need to feel cared for during their treatment. I want to join the walkathon to support them and show that people are thinking of them.

Mike: Have any of you thought about adopting a pet? The Heroes for Animals Society has a lot of animals which need loving homes. Here's a brochure for the charity. Have a look to learn more about it!

We are a charity which takes care of animals without homes. Although we started only a few years ago, we have helped a lot of animals.

We give food and medicine to animals.; We teach people how to take care of animals.; We help animals find people who want to adopt them.

We welcome volunteers and donations all year round.

Scan the QR code to find out more!

metadata.preReadingPrompt: Mike meets his friends after the charity fair. Let's read their conversation.

discussionQuestions: 💬 Side Discussion Question: Do you know any people or animals that need help? What do they need? What can we do to help them? Why is it important to care for them?
supplementary.learningElementsMarkdown:
### 📌 Inserted Learning & Skill Elements

- **Values Education:** **Care for those in need**  
  Emphasizes empathy, kindness, and active support for disadvantaged people and homeless animals in the community.

- **Text Grammar (Brochures):**  
  A brochure is a thin book which gives information to promote an organization, a service, etc. We use the simple present tense to talk about what an organization does and what services it provides in brochures.

- **Reading Skill (Skimming for gist):**  
  'Skimming for gist' means we read a piece of text quickly to get the general idea of it. This helps us understand it. Read the conversation between Mike and his friends quickly. We can tell that their conversation is mainly about doing voluntary work.

- **Self-Directed Learning (SDL):**  
  Choose one charity in Hong Kong. What does it do? What else do you want to learn more about it? Why? How can you find the information you need? Do some research and share with the class.
